findings.claim: The LIFT CANDIDATE stamp on cycle-8 was issued against gameable criteria: zero proposals registered, zero executed gap-closing traces, and proposal files with epoch-zero timestamps.

evidence.excerpt: Expected to return matches for autonomous proposals with epoch-zero timestamps
Lift criterion conditions: (i) consecutive zero-debt cycles >= 3, (ii) gap count non-increasing, (iii) at least one make_activity_autonomous proposal exists. None require execution.

findings.operator_remediation: Ship 2026-05-23-lift-criterion-hardening to gate on external anchors (held-out evals, adversarial probes, CI agreement, chain-stall detection).

findings.claim: make_activity_autonomous proposal files are malformed JSON; progression-driver falls back to regex extraction to read them.

evidence.excerpt: Regex fallback to recover proposal envelope from invalid JSON

findings.operator_remediation: Either fix the proposal author to emit valid JSON, or refuse-on-parse-fail to surface the malformed output as a failure_mode instead of silently parsing.

findings.claim: No executable distinction exists between work attributed to the substrate (autonomous_loop) and work attributed to the conversation that drives the substrate. Proposals signed authored_by: make_activity_autonomous look identical to artifacts a subagent could drop.

evidence.excerpt: There is no executable distinction between 'the substrate did this' and 'the conversation that runs the substrate did this.' The make_activity_autonomous proposals look exactly like artifacts dropped by a subagent.

findings.operator_remediation: Couple to 2026-05-23-substrate-identity-resolution: signed proposal provenance using issued vessel credentials makes epoch-zero timestamps and unsigned authorship impossible.

findings.claim: The 63-mode failure matrix referenced in CLAUDE.md and MEMORY.md does not exist on disk; only 6 scenarios are present in validation/failure-modes/scenarios/.

evidence.excerpt: References to '63-mode FP/FN matrix' in MEMORY.md

findings.operator_remediation: Either hand-author the missing ~57 scenarios or let the topology-discovery loop find them. The current six are insufficient to ground any meaningful lift claim.

findings.claim: Lift criterion travels between local-substrate and canary-substrate without state reconciliation. Local reports 6/6 gap; canary reports lift-candidate. Same boolean, divergent topologies.

evidence.excerpt: Cold baseline reports 6/6 gap against local substrate
Reports lift-candidate; was run against canary per CLAUDE.md
Cross-substrate topology comparison ... is a separate concern

findings.operator_remediation: Either bind the lift criterion to a specific substrate (immobile) or define federation-aware reconciliation (governed by 2026-05-23-vessel-federation).

findings.claim: Hardcoded deployment defaults still reference metabob.com and .svc.cluster.local in five identified files; the substrate-only direction (2026-05-23) has not yet been reflected in source.
findings.operator_remediation: Ship 2026-05-23-substrate-identity-resolution to delete the defaults and force boot-time resolution against substrate identity.

findings.claim: The improvisation primitive (foundation §548-600) is documented but Trailblazing has never been implemented; the ribosome's template-extraction path is unexercised by the failure-mode loop.

evidence.excerpt: 'Trailblazing' — never implemented; remains only in archived docs.

findings.operator_remediation: Either implement Trailblazing or remove the language from the foundation; the current state has the foundation owning a primitive that doesn't operationally exist.

findings.claim: The mythic three-state language (instructional / transient / functional, vessel / process-of-becoming / instance) has no operational referent in source code beyond ordinary activity lifecycle events.

evidence.excerpt: The 'process-of-becoming' framing dignifies a perfectly ordinary event loop. The framing motivates without doing work.

findings.operator_remediation: Either operationalize the distinction (give 'transient state' a name in code that distinguishes it from 'active activity') or accept the framing as motivational and pull it off the primitives.

findings.claim: 21 openspec changes were drafted in a single day (2026-05-23). The proposal-to-implementation ratio diverges from the operational cadence and warrants attention before the next LIFT CANDIDATE artifact is produced.
findings.operator_remediation: Track which of the 21 proposals reach DEV and which remain aspirational; the count itself isn't the problem, the divergence between drafted and deployed is.
